tabs.label: Open views
nav.label: Main
access.any.label: Any time
access.any.title: Connect any time
access.any.tech: You can connect without anyone at the PC. The owner chose this when they set up Support.
access.ask.label: Asks first
access.ask.title: Asks first
access.ask.tech: Someone at the PC clicks Allow before each connection. The owner chose this when they set up Support.
devices.title: Devices
devices.empty_text: Add a PC once and it stays here. Next time, select it and click Connect.
devices.select_text: Pick a PC from the list to see how it can be reached and to connect.
devices.pair_step1: Click Add a device and give the owner the pairing code.
devices.pair_step2: The owner installs Support and chooses whether you can connect any time or must ask first.
devices.pair_step3: The PC appears in your list. Select it and click Connect.
devices.pair_fine: For a PC you will help only once, send a one-off link instead. Nothing is saved.
device.owner_changes: Only the owner can change how you connect, from Support on their PC. If they uninstall Support, the PC leaves this list and all access ends.
connect.hint_ask: Someone at {name} is asked to click Allow.
connect.awaiting_title: Waiting for someone at {name} to click Allow
connect.awaiting_text: Support connects as soon as they allow it. Nothing happens on the PC until then.
connect.ended_early: The session with {name} ended before it started
connect.nothing_changed: Support did not connect, and nothing changed on that PC.
connect.failed_generic: The relay did not say why. Try again in a moment.
connect.busy_elsewhere: You are connecting to another PC. Wait for it, or cancel it, before you connect to this one.
connect.no_permission: Your role cannot start sessions on saved PCs.
connect.offline_seen: Last seen {when}. Connect becomes available when the PC is on and online.
connect.offline_text: Connect becomes available when the PC is on and online.
approve.title: {name} is waiting for approval
approve.text: Ask the person at the PC for the six-digit number on their screen, and enter it here to add the PC.
approve.label: Six-digit number shown on the PC
approve.wrong: That number does not match the one on the PC.
approve.not_pending: This PC is no longer waiting for approval.
approve.done: {name} is approved and added to your devices.
approve.no_permission: Your role cannot approve PCs. Ask someone who can manage devices.
approve.name_from_pc: The name above was typed on the PC that is asking to join. Check it with the person there.
add.title: Add a device
add.intro: Pair a PC once. After that it stays in your list.
add.step1: On the PC you want to add, the owner downloads and opens Support.
add.step3: They name the PC and choose whether you can connect any time or must ask first.
add.copied_link: Link copied. It carries the code, so send it only to the PC's owner.
add.waiting: Waiting for the PC to enter the code.
add.waiting_join: Waiting for the PC to finish joining.
add.waiting_approval: {name} asked to join and needs your approval.
add.code_failed: Could not make a pairing code.
add.no_permission: Your role cannot add devices. Ask someone who can manage devices.
link.title: Send a one-off link
link.text: For a PC you will help once. The customer opens the link, runs the app and clicks Allow. Nothing is saved to your devices, and access ends when the session does.
link.text2: For a PC you help often, add it as a device instead.
link.ready_text: Send it to the customer by message or email. It works once, within 10 minutes. This PC will not be saved to your devices.
link.copied: Link copied. It works once, within 10 minutes.
agent.hand_over_hint: The built-in agent works on the PC step by step. You watch from here.
agent.title_session: Hand this session to the agent
agent.text: Describe what is wrong and what you want done. The agent works as you, and you can pause or stop it at any time.
agent.placeholder: The receipt printer stopped printing. Find out why and fix it.
agent.models_failed: Could not load the agent's models.
agent.keep_working_help: Off by default. The agent stops after two minutes if nobody is watching.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.empty: Nothing yet. Task results, PCs waiting for approval and PCs that come online or go missing show up here.
notify.events_hint: Each event also shows in the Windows notifications of the PC this app runs on.
notify.watch_hint: Tell me when it is online: pick the PCs you want to hear about when they come back.
notify.watch_none: No saved PCs to watch yet.
notify.desktop_help: Turn this off to keep the list here but get no pop-ups on this PC.
notify.load_failed: Could not load your notification settings.
event.task_finished.name: A task finished
event.task_finished.help: The agent finished a task you started.
event.task_problem.name: A task needs you
event.task_problem.help: A task got stuck, failed, hit a spending cap, or was stopped because nobody watched.
event.session_declined.name: A session was turned down
event.session_declined.help: The person at a PC declined, nobody was there, or the owner ended the session.
event.device_online.name: A PC you watch came online
event.device_online.help: Only for the PCs you pick below.
event.device_missing.name: A PC went missing
event.device_missing.help: A PC left, or has not checked in for 7 days.
event.device_waiting.name: A PC is waiting for approval
event.device_waiting.help: A PC asked to join and needs the six-digit number.
settings.title: Settings
settings.accounts_hint: Each team you sign in to is one account. The sign-in is kept encrypted under your Windows account.
settings.sign_out_label: Sign out of {name} on this PC
settings.sign_out_text: This ends this PC's sign-in to the team on the relay and removes it from this PC. The team's PCs and data are not touched. You can sign in again at any time.
settings.other_teams: Other teams you belong to on this relay. Each needs its own approval in your browser.
settings.autostart_name: Start Support when I sign in to Windows
settings.autostart_help: Support starts hidden in the tray when you sign in to Windows, so notifications reach you.
settings.autostart_unavailable: Starting with Windows is not available in this build.
settings.autostart_failed: Could not change the start setting.
settings.update_ready: Version {version} is ready. It installs the next time the app starts.
settings.update_current: This is the newest version. Checked {when}.
settings.updates_fine: The app checks for a signed update when it starts and every 6 hours, and installs it quietly the next time it starts.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: Sign in to your team's relay. Your browser opens once to ask you to approve the app.
signin.signed_out_text: You were signed out. Sign in again to carry on.
signin.relay_help: The address of your team's Support relay, such as support.example.com.
signin.team_help: Most relays have one team, called default.
signin.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser. This window carries on when you approve the app.
signin.fine: The app asks to work as you in this team: see PCs and their screens, pair and approve PCs, and start agent tasks. It cannot change members, roles or agent keys.
session.ended_toast: Session ended. {name} is no longer connected.
session.cost_final: The task cost {spent} of the {cap} task cap.
session.task_paused_note: The task is paused. It sends nothing to the PC until you resume it.
session.no_picture: No picture yet. The first one arrives in a moment.
session.no_picture_ended: The session ended, so there is no picture.
session.cap_view_only: You are driving. The picture refreshes every few seconds. This tab only watches: you cannot click or type here yet.
session.cap_task: The agent is working. This is the last picture it took, and it changes when the agent takes another.
session.cap_task_waiting: The agent has not taken a picture yet. The next one shows here.
session.cap_task_paused: The task is paused. This is the last picture it took.
session.cap_not_driver: {who} is driving this PC, so this tab does not take pictures. Take over to watch it.
session.cap_driving: {who} is driving this PC now, so this tab stopped taking pictures.
session.cap_busy: The PC is busy with the agent, so this tab stopped taking pictures. It switches to the agent's picture when a task runs.
session.cap_failed: Taking pictures failed several times in a row, so this tab stopped.
session.cap_not_attached: The PC is not connected yet. The picture starts when it is.
session.took_over: You are driving this PC now.
